verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own REST API for managing "sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically" and supports adding unique custom domains to projects, with HTTPS provisioned automatically. That is a first-party basis for provisioning domains through code. Nothing in the pack describes multi-tenant SaaS customer domains: no per-tenant domain aliasing at scale, no host-based routing of customer domains to one app, and no API endpoint specifically for attaching custom domains. missing for 10: documented API for adding/verifying custom domains programmatically, multi-tenant customer-domain routing to a single deployment, per-tenant certificate provisioning at scale, limits on domain counts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API
Simplify domain management for your projects and add unique custom domains for different versions of your project.
